section_summary.extract_value: This section describes the Eating Disorder Examination Questionnaire (EDE-Q), a 28-item instrument assessing eating-related thoughts, feelings, and behaviours across four subscales (Restraint, Eating Concern, Weight Concern, and Shape Concern). The text notes that the EDE-Q has demonstrated good psychometric properties in various populations including men with eating disorders, U.S. undergraduates, and community samples of gay and bisexual men in the Netherlands. For the current study, only 12 diagnostic items were administered to reduce participant burden.
